find:
For each of the three positions, if the source gap has fewer cells than the
corresponding target gap (or conversely), bisect one cell on the side with
fewer cells.
replace:
Summing over the three gaps, if the source gaps have fewer cells in total
than the target gaps (or conversely), bisect one gap cell on the side with
fewer cells.

find: cells increases by one. Repeat until the numbers agree.
replace: cells increases by one. Repeat until the total numbers agree.
